question: What were outstanding case reserves at 31 December 2025?
final_text:
At 31 December 2025, outstanding case reserves were £15,020,532.03.

I got this by summing every `RESERVE` transaction in `claim_txn`. These are movements: a reserve is set when the claim opens, and it is reduced as payments are made and when the claim closes. So their running total is the reserve still outstanding. The data runs to 31 December 2025, so no date filter was needed.

I did not check whether any closed claims still carry a residual reserve.

ANSWER: 15020532.03

input.query: select txn_type, cost_type, count(*), sum(amount), min(txn_date), max(txn_date) from claim_txn group by all order by all

select c.claim_id, c.closed_date, t.txn_date, t.txn_type,t.cost_type,t.amount from claim c join claim_txn t using(claim_id) where c.claim_id in (select claim_id from claim order by claim_id limit 4) order by 1,3
